extension.description: Unofficial Plex for Kodi add-on: a reworked fork of PlexMod that installs beside it
Complemento no oficial de Plex para Kodi: una versión reelaborada de PlexMod que se instala junto a él
Inoffizielles Plex-Add-on für Kodi: eine überarbeitete Abspaltung von PlexMod, die sich daneben installieren lässt
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not supported by Plex
Este add-on no está respaldado por Plex
Dieses Addon wird nicht von der Firma Plex Inc. unterstützt
extension.news:
0.4.1 - pop-ups on CoreELEC - Pop-ups no longer stay on screen after Back on CoreELEC p3i builds - Questions and follow-ups open over the menu that asked them - Fixed: menu fonts and sidebar labels changing under a pop-up
0.4.0 - pop-ups and settings - Settings open in the option picker beside the sidebar, with each row's help - Menus, pickers and confirmations share one style - Editions on the details line, and as titles of their own in search - Watchlist: a show stays on until it has ended and is fully watched - Watchlist button on single-season shows - Previews and chapter images keep the film's shape - CoreELEC p3i: Direct Stream and transcodes start without waiting on border detection
0.3.0 - video player - Video player: a redesigned OSD, with chapters and the play queue as card rows - Video player: scan the timeline with FF/RW, or by holding left/right (Player UI setting) - Video player: preview thumbnails from the whole index file - no more green or black previews - TV spoilers: covers the hero, See more grids, playlists and search; hides previews instead of blurring them - Hub rows slide more smoothly; art loads over a plain card - Collections show how many items they hold - Fixed: auto-start with the stock PlexMod also installed
0.2.1 - Kodi 22 - Starts on Kodi 22 again - Replay after a single movie plays it again - Home and Recommended: a show without a clearlogo keeps its name over the episode
0.2.0 - settings - Settings reorganised: Playback and Playback (advanced); per-user settings marked - More settings apply as soon as Settings closes; ones that did nothing are gone - plex.direct mapping and the path-mapping share check work again - Rows, grids and Continue Watching update after playback, with current progress and art - Skipping the final credits goes to post-play - Slimmer progress bars on tiles
0.1.1 - refreshing - Refresh Hubs is on every row item's menu and refreshes the rows in place - Rows update in place after Remove from Continue Watching and Mark Played - Episodes and Seasons update after playback and after the screensaver or sleep - New episodes show up without leaving the screen - Single-season shows pick up what was watched
0.1.0 - first Plex Uno build, based on PlexMod 1.14.1. Installs beside the stock add-on. - A sidebar replaces the top bar: Home, Search, Watchlist, Playlists and your libraries from any server - Libraries: Recommended, Library, Categories and Collections tabs - Home: hub rows from every server with hero art; Manage Hubs and a Libraries picker - Show, Episodes, Pre-play, Artist, Album, Person, Collections and Playlists screens rebuilt - Search across every server, as a sidebar screen - Music plays through Plex play queues, with a rebuilt player - Multiple servers: offline, back online and gone servers handled - Mouse and touch input ignored by default (Settings, System) - Needs the Plextuary Uno skin, offered at startup
